append.maintenance: Drain and verify all messages every 5000 sends to remain below the default inbox limit; maintenance time included in wall rate

latency.cycle: Self-send, wait, verify identity/payload/receipt, then acknowledge cursor
latency.send_ack: Elapsed client call through durable fsync acknowledgment
latency.wait_after_send: Elapsed wait(timeout_s=0) call issued immediately after send acknowledgment; includes client parsing and transport

limitations: One host/filesystem and one run per condition; no confidence intervals
Self-send workload, fixed 128-byte text, closed-loop clients
Wait measurements begin after durable send ack and do not measure a preexisting waiter's wakeup
100 active clients increase offered concurrency; queueing is part of observed latency
Python client scheduling, parsing, GIL, and MCP wrapper overhead are included

conditions: 1 active / 100 enrolled; other agents have outstanding empty-inbox long polls
scale.relative_threshold_status: Diagnostic engineering choice, not a numeric specification requirement; report loaded concurrency and absolute target misses independently

transports.http: Persistent loopback HTTP/1.1 streamable HTTP MCP initialized session per agent
transports.uds: Persistent AF_UNIX NDJSON JSON-RPC connection per agent
